en.title: Autonomous E-commerce Operations Agent
en.description:
An intelligent AI agent platform that runs your entire online store on autopilot. ShopAI monitors inventory, adjusts pricing in real time, personalizes product recommendations, manages customer support, and optimizes ad spend — all using autonomous agents that learn from your store’s data and customer behavior.

**How It Works:**

**1. Real-Time Dashboard** - Live view of sales, inventory levels, customer sentiment, ad performance, and agent activity.

**2. Dynamic Pricing Agent** - Automatically adjusts prices based on demand, competitor pricing, inventory, and time of day.

**3. Personalized Recommendations** - AI agent analyzes browsing and purchase history to show the right product at the right time.

**4. 24/7 Customer Support Agent** - Handles FAQs, order tracking, returns, and escalates only complex issues to humans.

**5. Inventory & Reorder Agent** - Predicts stockouts, auto-reorders from suppliers, and prevents overstock.

**6. Ad Optimization Agent** - Allocates budget across Google, Meta, and TikTok based on ROAS and customer lifetime value.

**Technical Stack:** Frontend (SvelteKit, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Chart.js), Backend (Flask + Flask-SocketIO), AI Agents (LangChain, LangGraph), Data (PostgreSQL, Redis), Integrations (Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Google Ads, Meta), Infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes).

fr.title: Agent IA Autonome pour E-commerce
fr.description:
Une plateforme d’agents IA qui gère votre boutique en ligne de A à Z : tarification dynamique, recommandations personnalisées, support client 24/7, gestion de stock et optimisation publicitaire — le tout en apprenant en continu à partir de vos données.

**Fonctionnalités clés :** tableau de bord temps réel, agent prix, agent support, agent stock, agent pub. Intégration Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe.
